# Just Bin Bags

> > UK supplier of commercial waste disposal solutions including heavy-duty bin bags, clinical waste sacks, and industrial packaging materials.

Just Bin Bags Limited, based in Altrincham, offers a comprehensive range of waste management products from light-duty pedal bin liners to extra heavy-duty compactor sacks (160-200 gauge), specialized clinical waste bags, and packaging supplies. Products are categorized by strength ratings including MONTANA, JET, ZIRCON, EMERALD, CEDAR, AQUARIUS, and DIAMOND ranges.

## Key Topics

- Heavy-duty bin bags
- Extra heavy-duty waste disposal
- Gauge ratings (80-200 gauge)
- Micron thickness (20-50 micron)
- Clinical waste bags
- Tiger stripe sacks
- Soluble strip laundry bags
- Infection control supplies
- Square bin liners
- Wheelie bin liners
- Clear heavy duty bags
- Compactor sacks
- Rubble sacks
- Pallet wrapping materials
- Documents Enclosed Wallets
